issue.title: test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion fails under full parallel lane
issue.description: During mirrored_bead_status_sync verification on 2026-08-12, just check escalated to the full non-visual suite and failed tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion plus the already-tracked logs-pane flake. The current diff touches external issue mirroring, CLI/help/docs, and mirror tests, not snippet modal behavior. The exact snippet-modal node passed immediately in isolation with .venv/bin/pytest tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion -vv. Scope: root-cause the full-parallel/pass-isolation failure by mechanism or decide whether this node belongs in the reproducible-flake baseline with this bead named.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired umbrella for ACE TUI full-parallel/pass-isolation flakes; its close policy routes new nodes like this into narrow tasks rather than reopening the umbrella.

RELATED: sase-jb — same just check full-lane run also reproduced tests/ace/tui/test_logs_pane.py::test_logs_tab_g_and_shift_g_scroll_detail_extremes, already tracked there; a shared ACE/TUI parallel-lane mechanism may bear on both.

payload.close_reason: Backlog cut to seven (owner-requested, 2026-08-12): folded into sase-jq. Same signature as sase-jb and sase-jq -- fails in the full parallel lane, passes immediately in isolation, diff untouched by the failing area -- and it was reported from the very same sase-k2.4 check run that re-reported sase-jb. One reproduction so far, and it is not among the 7 nodes the flake-baseline gate currently names (verified at HEAD 42e60e5d6), so it blocks nobody today. sase-jq owns this flake class; root-causing the parallel-lane mechanism there is the fix that would cover this node too. Reopen with a +1 if this node starts blocking the gate on its own.

evidence.note: Current CI-stabilization verification on 2026-08-14 after this task's close reran 'tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake' on this checkout. The gate exits 1 and now names tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion among 16 reproducible-flake node IDs exceeding tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt. This is gate-blocking durable-record evidence rather than a live full-lane test failure; the local diff has not touched the snippet modal.

payload.entry: AUDIT sase-mi.1 at HEAD de83c802d: commit 5601920c9 added tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion under # sase-ke. The 2026-08-14T22:12Z reopen +1 predates that commit (22:20Z). tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake exits 0: no new reproducible flakes (0 current, 18 allowed). payload.close_reason: Baseline entry added by 5601920c9; flake gate reports no new flakes

evidence.note: Independently reproduced 2026-08-18 after the 2026-08-16 close (baseline-only) on a tree that contains 5601920c9. just test-scoped escalated to the full 14-worker lane and failed tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion with AssertionError: assert 'todo' in '  Checking matches…'. Serial rerun of that exact node on the same tree passed. The kill-and-edit diff does not touch the snippet modal. Live test still flakes under the full parallel lane even though the flake-baseline gate no longer names it.

SECOND NODE IN THE SAME FILE, same signature — from sase-p3.15.land's full-suite landing verification for epic sase-p3 (2026-08-18, workspace sase_12, HEAD 11f78656d). 'just test' over 33821 items with 14 xdist workers reported '1 failed, 33808 passed, 12 skipped in 462.10s'; the sole failure was tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_new_trigger_returns_empty_starting_body. It then passed 3/3 as an isolated serial rerun and 8/8 as a serial run of the whole file, on the same unchanged tree. The diff under test was nothing — a clean checkout of master with no local changes — so it is not attributable to any in-flight work. Filing here rather than as a new task because this bead's scope is already 'root-cause the full-parallel/pass-isolation failure by mechanism', and the mechanism looks shared: at tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py:121 the failing node does 'await pilot.pause(0.25)' and then asserts the verdict Static reads 'Create ⇥ todo', which is the same fixed-wall-clock-settle shape that makes this file's nodes lose under a full-width lane. IMPORTANT DIFFERENCE FROM THE BASELINED NODE: test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion is carried in tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt:107 under '# sase-ke', but test_new_trigger_returns_empty_starting_body is NOT in that file at all, so nothing absorbs it. Whoever fixes the mechanism should cover both nodes; whoever instead chooses the baseline route needs a second entry, not just the existing one.

Forwarded PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP from sase-ri.4: test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion failed under an escalated full-suite lane and passed on the exact rerun; same full-parallel/pass-isolation node tracked here.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by dbb05112e 'test(ace): wait for snippet-name modal analysis to settle' (2026-08-20): the snippet-name tests had pause(0.25) after a 150ms-debounced off-thread collision check and now wait on the settled verdict or matches instead. tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt attributes the retirement to sase-rm.9 by name -- '(sase-ke, sase-og, sase-r7, sase-rf)' -- and carries '# fixed-at: 2026-08-20T19:05:00Z' for test_matches_filter_order_and_tab_completion. The one +1 timestamped after that instant is a forwarded sase-ri.4 observation from a pre-fix tree, the Known-limitation case the baseline header documents. 'tools/selection_health --fail-on-new-flake' exits 0 on 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
